item.description:
SubFuse 1.0

Your AI subscriptions. One clear view.

  • Daily usage history, compact provider graphs and an expandable Home graph.
  • Combined Usage with comparable credits, including supported ChatGPT Pro 100 plans.
  • Weekly efficiency monitoring and eligible unused-value estimates.
  • A cleaner interface with provider accents, matching calendar colours and desktop widgets.
  • Separate periodic refresh and daily history controls, plus encrypted profile export with history.

This updates SubFuse Beta directly. Existing profiles, sign-ins, costs, renewals and refresh settings are retained. History starts with new readings; past usage is not backfilled.

The installed filename may remain SubFuse Beta.app; the application inside is SubFuse 1.0. Private preview profiles remain separate and can be exported/restored explicitly.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. Ad hoc signed; not Apple-notarized.
